## Summary

Seasoned front-end engineer specialising in software architecture, TypeScript, React, CSS, and modern testing practices. Author of "Reactive Programming with Angular and NGRX" (Apress). Co-Founder & Lead Software Engineer of ReadM (https://readm.app), an AI-powered reading fluency assessment tool for K–4 students.

## Experience

**Senior & Lead UI Engineer — ZScaler** (2026 – Present)
Hands-on architect and implementer of scalable UI solutions using React, TypeScript, and Playwright, while establishing TDD standards and upskilling 5+ engineers through direct mentorship.
Tech: React, Vite, MUI, TypeScript, Tanstack-Table, GraphQL, Tanstack-Query, Vitest, Playwright, CSS, GitHub Actions.

**Lead UI Engineer — HighRes BioSolutions** (2024 – 2026)
Hands-on lead engineer driving UI excellence by implementing BDD with Playwright, reducing UI production bugs, and mentoring team members on React & TypeScript best practices.
Tech: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind, Tanstack-Query, CSS, Playwright.

**CTO & Lead Software Engineer — AKTO SPACE** (2023 – 2024)
Advised on tech direction and led hands-on development of a desktop application from start to finish with Electron.js and React.
Tech: React, TypeScript, CSS, ChakraUI, Electron.js, Node.js.

**Senior Front End Tech Lead / Engineer — Rivery** (2022 – 2023)
Hands-on lead personally driving the migration from Angular 1 to React/Redux/RTK-Query, designing the architecture, and integrating ChakraUI.
Tech: React, RTK Toolkit, RTK Query, TypeScript, Chakra UI, SCSS, Cypress, Testing Library, StoryBook, GitHub Actions.

**Head of Front End Engineering / Tech Lead — 1Care.ai** (2020 – 2022)
Led front-end development with a team of 3 engineers to create web & mobile applications.
Tech: React, React Native (Android/iOS), TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Blueprint, SCSS, Cypress, Jest, Testing Library, GraphQL, AWS/Amplify.

**Senior Front End Engineer & Consultant — Tangent Logic** (2018 – 2020)
Developed web applications focused on reusability and testing with React, Angular, TypeScript, Redux, NGRX.
Notable client: Lifion — React, Node.js, Jest, Enzyme, Testing Library, TypeScript, Sass.

**Senior Front End Engineer & Consultant — Orizens (Self-Owned)** (2016 – 2018)
Built web applications with React, Angular, Redux, NgRx, TypeScript. Personal projects include ReadM, Echoes Player, and open-source npm packages used by Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Disney, and SAP.

**Senior Front End Engineer, Front End Architect — Tikal Knowledge** (2010 – 2016)
Developed web applications with Angular, Backbone, React, Node.js. Led Tikal's JavaScript Group, ran workshops, and consulted for enterprise customers.

**UI Front End Developer — Comverse** (2008 – 2010)
Developed web GUI for internal applications using OOP JavaScript, Ajax, HTML, CSS, XML & XSLT. Refactored UI to a component-based architecture.

**Web Developer & Designer Freelance — Orizens.com** (2005 – 2010)
Designed and developed websites using HTML, JS, CSS, PHP, WordPress, Flash & ActionScript.
